name: CeylonDrive
description: Enterprise-grade tourism and chauffeur logistics platform for Sri Lanka, featuring dynamic route pricing, multi-day itinerary generation, real-time dispatch via WebSockets and Telegram, and automated Google Ads optimization.
features: Dynamic airport transfer pricing engine via Google Maps Distance Matrix; custom multi-day itinerary generator; driver fleet discovery; instant automated dispatch alerts via Telegram Bot webhooks and WhatsApp Business; autonomous Google Ads script powered by Google Gemini 1.5 Flash AI for automated negative keyword mining and search term optimization.
note: Live production platform deployed on Oracle Cloud VPS with Apache 2.4, Let's Encrypt SSL/TLS, and Cloudflare CDN. Verified 4.9★ Google Places API review sync.

name: BLACK SOUL
description: Immersive direct-to-consumer streetwear storefront and music platform combining real-time 3D merchandise customization, persistent audio streaming, and multi-tier checkout.
features: Interactive 3D merchandise customizer using React Three Fiber (@react-three/drei) and Three.js for 360° orbital product inspection and multi-zone decal placement; persistent Web Audio streaming player with animated frequency visualizers; hybrid checkout with PayHere gateway, Bank Deposit QR code generation, and slip verification; headless Sanity v4 Studio with GROQ queries; automated 25% profit-split reporting dashboard dedicated to verified community charity initiatives.
note: Production e-commerce and media platform built for hip-hop artist YAZZY, combining apparel drops with continuous music streaming and charitable profit allocation.

name: Vellora Fashion
description: Modern fashion and lifestyle e-commerce storefront presenting curated apparel, beauty, and accessories collections with a responsive visual identity, intuitive catalog discovery, and smooth cart workflows.
features: Dynamic collection discovery, faceted catalog search and navigation, wishlist management, and a streamlined shopping cart workflow.
note: High-performance headless e-commerce frontend deployed on Vercel's global edge network, optimized for fast initial render and Core Web Vitals.

name: Ceylon C Tours
description: Professional chauffeur and travel services website showcasing vehicle fleet categories, popular Sri Lankan destination circuits, and direct ride enquiry channels.
features: Fleet catalog highlighting vehicle capacities and luggage limits, curated Sri Lanka tour highlights, and clear WhatsApp and web-based ride enquiry routing.
note: Client travel presence presenting vehicle categories, passenger capacities, and sightseeing itineraries with rapid customer enquiry turnaround.

name: 3S 3D Engineering Service
description: Visual business website for an architectural visualization and engineering studio, highlighting 3D rendering capabilities, BIM services, and project consultations.
features: High-resolution architectural project galleries, detailed breakdowns of architectural workflows, and structured enquiry intake for international clients.
note: Client business platform showcasing architectural visualization, Building Information Modeling (BIM), and engineering consultation capabilities.

name: SecureFolder Locker
description: Modern high-security Windows desktop folder encryption suite engineered with authenticated AES-256-GCM chunked encryption, Argon2id key derivation, and crash-resilient transaction journaling.
features: True in-place authenticated encryption using AES-256-GCM in 64 KB chunks; Argon2id key derivation (64 MB, 4 iterations, 4 lanes); write-through transaction journal for automatic crash recovery; PathGuard safety engine preventing locking system paths; sub-second master password re-wrapping; single-file portable executable with zero network dependencies.
note: Standalone desktop security software engineered for Windows 10/11 x64, packaged as an offline portable executable with zero external cloud dependencies.

name: OpenSearch Intelligence Engine (OSIE)
description: Private hybrid search engine and autonomous research agent combining Robertson-Spärck Jones BM25 Okapi inverted indexing, dense vector embeddings, Tor circuit isolation, and multi-source dossier synthesis.
features: Robertson-Spärck Jones BM25 Okapi inverted indexer with exact phrase boosting; subword LSA and Ollama dense vector embeddings (384-dim); hybrid score fusion; bounded crawler with SSRF mitigation; Tor onion crawling with DNS leak isolation via local SOCKS5 proxy; autonomous research agent synthesizing structured dossiers into Markdown, JSON, and CSV.
note: Internal research system and private intelligence engine engineered as a modular monolith with decoupled React TypeScript frontend.

name: Smart Home OS
description: Production-ready, 100% local smart home automation ecosystem with zero cloud dependencies, powered by Home Assistant, Mosquitto MQTT broker, Node-RED visual logic, local AI voice pipelines, and Frigate NVR computer vision.
features: Modular Docker-based microservices architecture running locally from Raspberry Pi 4 to Intel NUC; local voice pipeline using Whisper (STT), Piper (TTS), and Ollama (LLM); Frigate NVR for hardware-accelerated computer vision object detection over RTSP; Zigbee2MQTT broker; Prometheus and Grafana telemetry.
note: Privacy-first local smart home platform delivering commercial-grade automation without third-party cloud lock-in.

name: QuantOps Algorithmic Trading Engine
description: Automated quantitative crypto futures paper-trading platform integrating Freqtrade, FreqAI, CCXT exchange adapters, and machine learning models with walk-forward validation and strict risk guardrails.
features: Containerized order execution and feature engineering pipeline using Freqtrade and FreqAI in Docker; walk-forward adaptive feature training using XGBoost and LightGBM across multi-timeframe OHLCV data; strictly enforced policy-driven risk controls with dry-run paper trading, capped balances, and automated trailing stop-losses; automated security scanners for configuration verification.
note: Supervised algorithmic research platform operating strictly in paper-trading simulation with policy-driven execution controls.

name: Buddhist Organization Governance Platform (BOGP)
description: Comprehensive enterprise multi-tenant governance, double-entry fund accounting, and compliance system architecture designed for community institutions, temples, and humanitarian NGOs.
features: Modular monolith specification with strict trust boundaries; rigorous segregation of duties enforced via server-side ABAC and PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS); tamper-evident audit trails; outbox pattern for reliable asynchronous workflows; multi-entity double-entry fund accounting ledger; restricted budget allocations; automated bank reconciliation matching; zero-leakage privacy guarantees.
note: Enterprise systems architecture and governance specification designed to scale from single institutions to multi-branch networks.

name: Kasagala Young Buddhist Association
description: Bilingual (Sinhala/English) community management and humanitarian fundraising platform featuring member registration, verification workflows, project progress tracking, and multi-currency donation management.
features: TanStack Start SSR with type-safe RPC server functions; TanStack Router file-based routing; React 19 concurrent rendering; dual database engine supporting embedded PGlite (WASM PostgreSQL) for local development and Neon PostgreSQL for cloud production; unique membership number assignment (KYBA-YYYY-XXXX); donation tracking with receipt verification; humanitarian project progress tracking; lightweight custom i18n engine with full Sinhala and English dictionaries.
note: Staged deployment for the Kasagala Youth Buddhist Association community and fundraising portal, currently in active rollout.

name: Dhamma Quotes — Offline AI Image Editor
description: Offline-first Android AI image editor that intelligently overlays bilingual (Sinhala & English) Dhamma reflections on photos using on-device computer vision.
features: On-device image analysis using a lightweight TensorFlow Lite DeepLabv3 semantic segmentation model to detect image composition and identify optimal safe zones for text placement; GPU delegate acceleration with background Dart isolates for asynchronous image processing; Riverpod state management; sqflite local persistence; bilingual ARB localization.
note: Mobile application engineered for offline-first resilience with on-device computer vision and zero external cloud dependency.

name: Facebook Post Scheduler
description: Multi-channel social media content management utility designed for calendar-based campaign planning, post queueing, and workflow automation.
features: Visual scheduling calendar, post composition interface with rich media preview, queue management, and automated publishing workflow concepts.
note: Beta utility exploring calendar-driven content scheduling and campaign planning workflows.
